title: Không có bột ngọt, làm ơn
pronunciation: Khong co bot ngot lam on
summary: Keeps the food or drink request clear in a stall, cafe, or busy counter.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Point to the item, menu line, receipt, size, or photo.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Không có bột ngọt, làm ơn as one clean sentence; the menu line, dish photo, bill, or ingredient can carry the exact detail. Point to the item, menu line, receipt, size, or photo.

phrases.vietnamese: Không có bột ngọt, làm ơn
phrases.pronunciation: Khong co bot ngot lam on

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Practice Không có bột + ngọt, làm ơn first; the full line keeps the request from sounding chopped up.

breakdown.vietnamese: Không có bột ngọt, làm ơn

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: It belongs at a stall, cafe, or restaurant counter when ingredient check, safer dish, or replacement order may become the next detail.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể làm món này không có nguyên liệu này được không?
phrases.english: Can you make it without this ingredient?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the lam mon nay khong co nguyen lieu nay duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Món ăn nào an toàn nhất cho người bị dị ứng này?
phrases.english: Which dish is safest for this allergy?
phrases.pronunciation: Mon an nao an toan nhat cho nguoi bi di ung nay

phrases.vietnamese: Đây là thịt lợn, thịt bò hay thịt gà?
phrases.english: Is this pork, beef, or chicken?
phrases.pronunciation: Day la thit lon thit bo hay thit ga

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có chứa tôm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co chua tom khong

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Menus and photos do a lot of work. Point to the item while you say the phrase so the reply can stay short.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: If the exchange continues, can I order this without meat?; I am allergic to fish sauce; I am allergic to shellfish can carry the next detail.

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có nước mắm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co nuoc mam khong

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể gọi món này mà không có thịt được không?
phrases.english: Can I order this without meat?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the goi mon nay ma khong co thit duoc khong

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the answer changes what you need, try no meat, please; can you make it without this ingredient?; which dish is safest for this allergy?
